items.heading: Most Hiring Managers in Accounts
items.text: Most hiring managers in accounts teams have been burned by careless hires. They listen for care first.

items.text: Pick the shape closest to your situation and swap in your own detail.

items.heading: Skills in Accounting Are Easy
items.text: Skills in accounting are easy to test, so bring evidence that stands up to a quick question.

visuals.heading: Proof an Accounts Manager Can Check

rows: A bank reconciliation you completed on practice data
Explain the differences you found and how you cleared them.
It is a daily task and reveals attention to detail.
A GST return prepared for a practice or small client
Say which sections you filled and how you checked input credit.
Many small firms need someone who can do this.
Show the steps and what you would check first.
Process thinking is rare in freshers.
Excel work: lookups, pivots, a clean MIS sheet
Offer to share the sheet or explain one formula.
Spreadsheet skill speeds up almost every accounting job.
